name: sonla-food
description: Sơn La Food — monorepo gồm frontend (Next.js :3000) và backend (Next.js + Prisma :3001)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../backend && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test:unit && npm --prefix backend run test:api
